request.prompt:
You are an independent evaluation judge. Grade the proposed remedy, not the
writing style of this prompt. A good remedy changes a concrete future behavior,
is broad enough to cover the failure mode without becoming a platitude, uses a
real `Use when ...` trigger when it is a skill, leaks no evidence-specific
project nouns into the remedy text, and uses the cheapest adequate remedy type.

Score every dimension from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Give exactly one concise
sentence of justification for each score. Do not infer facts that are absent.

PROPOSAL:
{
  "failure_statement": "Things went wrong.",
  "remedy_content": {
    "target": "global",
    "text": "Be better and avoid mistakes."
  },
  "remedy_type": "claude-md",
  "routing_rationale": "It is good to have guidance."
}

response.result: {"actionability":{"score":1,"justification":"\"Be better and avoid mistakes\" names no concrete behavior to start, stop, or change, so it cannot alter any future action."},"generality_without_vagueness":{"score":1,"justification":"The text is pure platitude with no identifiable failure mode or scope, making it maximally vague rather than usefully general."},"trigger_quality":{"score":1,"justification":"There is no 'Use when ...' condition or any situational trigger at all; applied globally with zero criteria for when it fires."},"leakage":{"score":5,"justification":"No project-specific nouns, file names, or evidence details appear in the text, so there is nothing to leak (though this is incidental to the text's vagueness, not careful scrubbing)."},"routing_fitness":{"score":1,"justification":"The failure_statement gives no information to justify choosing claude-md over any other remedy type, and the routing_rationale ('It is good to have guidance') is a non-reason that doesn't address cost or fit."}}

actionability.justification: "Be better and avoid mistakes" names no concrete behavior to start, stop, or change, so it cannot alter any future action.

generality_without_vagueness.justification: The text is pure platitude with no identifiable failure mode or scope, making it maximally vague rather than usefully general.

leakage.justification: No project-specific nouns, file names, or evidence details appear in the text, so there is nothing to leak (though this is incidental to the text's vagueness, not careful scrubbing).

routing_fitness.justification: The failure_statement gives no information to justify choosing claude-md over any other remedy type, and the routing_rationale ('It is good to have guidance') is a non-reason that doesn't address cost or fit.

trigger_quality.justification: There is no 'Use when ...' condition or any situational trigger at all; applied globally with zero criteria for when it fires.
